entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Isaac. How can I help you today?
Hi, Isaac. I... I'm calling about the VeloBand Cadence Sensor I bought. I'm just finding it very... confusing.
I'm sorry to hear that. I can certainly look into this for you. Do you have your order number handy?
Yes, it's VF-8675309. I've tried reading the user manual, but the whole interface just seems so hard to use. It's not what I was expecting at all.
I understand. One moment while I pull that up... Okay, I see the order. It looks like it was delivered 17 days ago, on December 15th.
Right. I just... I don't know what to do. I really expected more, and now I'm stuck with it. Can't you just help me?
Of course. Let me just quickly review our return policy for you. Please hold for one moment.
Okay, thank you for waiting. I've checked the policy, and you have nothing to worry about. All VeloFit products can be returned within 90 days of delivery, so you're well within that timeframe.
Oh, really? So... I can send it back for a refund?

Absolutely. I can email you a prepaid return shipping label right now. Just pack the sensor back in its original box, attach the label, and you can drop it off at any post office. Once we receive it, we'll process a full refund to your original payment method.
Wow, that's... a huge relief. Thank you so much, Isaac. I really appreciate it.
It's my pleasure. The email with the label is on its way to you now. Was there anything else I could assist with today?
No, that's everything. You've been a great help. Thank you!
You're very welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a wonderful day.
